The '''yellowtail ibbot hawk''' was one of the sixty-eight [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[ibbot]] [[Bird/Legends|bird]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]]. While most ibbot species fed on [[Algae/Legends|algae]], the yellowtail ibbot [[Hawk/Legends|hawk]] was [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]]. As with every ibbot species, the yellowtail was evolved to fill a particular niche in Drall's ecosystem.<ref name="CatCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The yellowtail ibbot hawk was mentioned in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CatCW" />
